title: Vibrant Swirling Sky Over Fields
description: A person sees a bright yellow sun setting on the horizon with swirling orange and red patterns filling the sky above rolling hills and green fields. Many large blue circles of different sizes float across the upper part of the scene with smaller blue dots scattered around them.
prompt: A vibrant expressionist painting shows a bright yellow sun setting behind distant purple hills with rolling fields of green yellow and orange stretching across the foreground. The sky is filled with swirling patterns of red orange and yellow paint while many large solid blue circles and smaller blue dots float across the upper portion of the image in an energetic composition.
